# Independent early-November open water near Mopti

Each GeoTIFF is a native-resolution, 20 m Sentinel-2 Level-2A scene classification (SCL) cutout covering 100 km² around the midpoint of SWOT reach 14279000471. All scenes share MGRS tile 30PUB and relative orbit 008. UTM 30N bounds are 365560–375560 m east and 1601980–1611980 m north. The Earth Search STAC query, scene ID, time, processor baseline, source and chip hash are recorded in `mopti_early_november_water.csv`. [Earth Search](https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1/collections/sentinel-2-l2a) · [Sentinel-2 processing and classification](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/s2-processing)

For each year the comparison uses the nearest qualifying overpass to 8 November within 1–15 November. Ties favor the earlier acquisition and then newer processing baseline. Reported acquisition age is relative to the 2024 measured crest at Mopti. The same calendar date can fall on different hydraulic phases in other years. Reject scenes with over 5% of the footprint in SCL classes 0, 1, 3, 8, 9, 10 or 11. Read counts from the fixed window using `python3 mopti_water.py` with GDAL and NumPy. `candidates_examined.csv` records each attempted scene through acceptance.

The lower figure counts only SCL water (6). The upper assigns all ambiguous, masked and cloud-affected pixels to water, including SCL 2 and 7. Thus they bound the **classification ambiguity under the assumed labels**. Water beneath vegetation, turbid water classified as land, and incorrect clear-land/water labels can lie outside those bounds. They do not represent physical uncertainty intervals. Processing baseline changes, including an early 2018 baseline, complicate long-term comparisons. The fixed-footprint Nov 2023 water class occupied 7.07 km² versus 18.22 km² in Nov 2024 and 13.28 km² in Nov 2025. This check concerns open water around the reach and does not estimate channel width or discharge.
